description: Token-reduction transformations in holon-coherence lack a composable structural ReductionPass Protocol and ordered pass registry, making it difficult to register, reorder, toggle, or isolate individual reduction passes cleanly without modifying JSONContextCleaner core control flow.
goal: Introduce src/holon_coherence/reduction_passes.py (at most 200 lines) defining a runtime_checkable structural ReductionPass Protocol (with name property/attribute, applies(provider, payload) -> bool, and apply(payload, context) -> dict[str, Any]), a ReductionContext dataclass carrying cleaner settings, seen_content_hashes, stats, and provider name, and an ordered ReductionPassRegistry supporting registration, deterministic iteration, and enabled_passes/disabled_passes filtering. Update JSONContextCleaner in src/holon_coherence/payload_cleaner.py (at most 200 lines) to accept an optional pass_registry and optional enabled_passes/disabled_passes collections, executing its built-in ProviderCleanPass through the same deterministic pass pipeline while preserving 100% of existing process_payload and process_payload_with_stats behaviour. Add unit tests in tests/test_reduction_passes.py covering structural Protocol conformance, deterministic ordering, pass toggling/isolation, and custom third-party ReductionPass injection without editing JSONContextCleaner, and register src/holon_coherence/reduction_passes.py in tests/test_core_self_doc.py (keep zero docstrings and zero comments across all touched files). Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: A structural ReductionPass Protocol decouples individual token-reduction transforms from JSONContextCleaner, enabling composable pass testing, toggling, and future A/B evaluation without hardcoding branches.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/reduction_passes.py defines a runtime_checkable ReductionPass Protocol, ReductionContext, and ordered ReductionPassRegistry within the 200-line module budget.

JSONContextCleaner in src/holon_coherence/payload_cleaner.py runs registered ReductionPass instances in deterministic order, honours enabled_passes/disabled_passes filtering, and stays within 200 lines while keeping existing clean/stats outputs identical by default.
Adding and executing a custom ReductionPass in tests/test_reduction_passes.py requires zero edits to payload_cleaner.py control flow.
tests/test_core_self_doc.py includes src/holon_coherence/reduction_passes.py with zero docstrings or disallowed comments across all four files.
Existing provider, proxy, and ab_testing test suites pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes cleanly.
Adding a new token-reduction strategy requires implementing and registering a ReductionPass without modifying clean_payload.py control flow or provider string branches.
Unit tests verify deterministic ordering, toggle/isolation, and A/B pass comparison.
